scope.statement: Every markdown checkbox marked [x] in the repository at the audited HEAD, plus the current registry and receipt ledgers. A checkbox classification describes the strongest claim supported by that checkbox, not every implementation detail named inside it.

classification_definitions.scientific_completion: The registered claim, sample and seed level, controls, source and config bindings, and independent positive verifier are all present. Scope remains exactly the receipt scope.
classification_definitions.confirmatory_result: A focused multi-seed control resolves a named contention, but the chain does not meet every current project-wide binding or generalization requirement.
classification_definitions.pilot: A real execution produced an interpretable directional result, but sample size, task scope, controls, natural inputs, or binding prevents promotion.
classification_definitions.mechanics_only: Execution, integrity, availability, resource, accounting, smoke, or ledger mechanics are verified. No scientific result is licensed.
classification_definitions.scaffold: Code, config, registry, preregistration, orchestration, documentation, or a fail-closed path exists. The registered study is not thereby complete.
classification_definitions.stale_unbound: The statement is superseded, lacks a current raw or source binding, uses historical counts, or conflicts with newer evidence.
classification_definitions.failed_null: The registered or focused result is a tie, null, failed verifier, refutation, or retired regime. This is a completed negative result only at its exact scope.
classification_definitions.data_rights_blocked: The first honest blocker is rights-clean data, human review, environment access, or a citable input, not hardware.
classification_definitions.implementation_blocked: The first honest blocker is missing local implementation despite a locally feasible design.
classification_definitions.measured_hardware_blocked: A repeated, named, non-factorizable current-host boundary with an enabling rung has been measured. No audited claim qualifies.

checkbox_claim_groups.qualification: This composite checkbox must be decomposed: eleven F positives are bound scientific completions on structured synthetic or local scope; six F legs are bound nulls; F10 fails; F8 and F16 are environment scaffolds.
Focused synthetic closure controls with durable artifact hashes. Their raw JSON files do not embed current-standard source and config hashes, so they are not project-wide scientific completions.

current_non_F_ledger.semantic_warning: Freshly executed means a bounded class codepath with finite metrics and a hashed attempt receipt. It does not mean the registered multi-seed study is complete. Runnable-not-yet-run zero therefore cannot close P4, P5, or other standalone full campaigns.

discrepancies.finding: The audit found that the prior receipt set studio_is_only_remaining_hardware_boundary and ready_for_studio_handoff true despite an empty measured-boundary set and explicit non-hardware blockers. The generator was repaired during this audit and the receipt regenerated.
discrepancies.resolution: Current receipt sets both booleans false and gives three refusal reasons: the scientific verdict ledger is not ready, no measured and validated Studio hardware boundary exists, and data, rights, environment, or provenance blockers remain.

discrepancies.finding: All 177 entries have scientific_claim_ready false. The zero runnable-not-yet-run count tracks class execution and durable artifacts, not full registered campaigns.
discrepancies.required_correction: Add a separate full-study completion state and do not use this count to close P4, P5, or multi-seed science.

discrepancies.finding: The five-seed P4 campaign closed all 12 registered cells, with six cells stopped by the preregistered futility rule and 48 observations in the response-surface fit.
discrepancies.resolution: The canonical proof equals the completed run receipt byte for byte, and governor leg5 closed with status complete and an empty active-lane set. The result remains a programmatic pilot and refuses confirmatory promotion by construction.

discrepancies.finding: P5 code, preregistration, class smoke, and a mechanics-only memory trace exist, but the full pilot proof is absent. After P4 released the lane, three governed smoke samples failed only the current available-memory headroom gate.
discrepancies.required_correction: When three consecutive unchanged admission samples are healthy, run p5smoke, the cold-process training-grid memory pass, then p5pilot. Do not weaken the memory gate or infer hardware necessity from this transient denial.

discrepancies.finding: The audit found that CM7 and CM8 still referred to the old one-seed calibration state.
discrepancies.resolution: The hardened frontier receipt consumes the five-seed familywise-corrected CM7 null, verifies E6/DR14 dense integration, and removes the retired scale pilot from current AL2/DR5 classification. CM8 states that positive objective-lever evidence is absent and a successor design is required.

discrepancies.finding: The audit found an E6 row that still instructed already-completed model acquisition and forward probing.
discrepancies.resolution: The requirements matrix and exhaustion ledger bind official runtime and task/cache/control integration, classify E6 and DR14 as natural data/cache/verification blocked, and remove retired-scale requirements. Implementation is complete for the registered seam.

discrepancies.finding: The inherited-scale pilot had complete identity/control mechanics but was still consumed as current frontier and requirements evidence.
discrepancies.resolution: The immutable pilot and identity receipts remain historical evidence. Active selectors are absent, frontier and requirements no longer depend on the pilot, and its n=8 generated result remains non-promotable.

discrepancies.finding: Historical text calls one inherited encoder's MPS failure Studio-necessary and cites an approximately 821-second MPS result. Current CPU and official dense evidence refutes the necessity claim, while the 821-second value has no retained raw machine receipt.
discrepancies.required_correction: Treat MPS as a poor path on this host, not a hardware necessity. Do not cite 821 seconds as authoritative.

discrepancies.finding: Numerous checked test, registry, stage, and cost counts describe older commits. They may be historical facts but are not current verification and should not be used as live completion evidence.
discrepancies.required_correction: Keep as chronology or move to a retrospective. Current status should cite only fresh generated counts.

discrepancies.finding: A queued 432-clip cache and replication run is marked [x] even though the checkbox describes scheduling, not completion.
discrepancies.required_correction: Use [~] until the receipt exists, or replace with the later measured n=8 atlas state.

discrepancies.finding: The e7, ex5, and ex2 closure JSON bytes are durable and exact in the artifact index, but the raw receipts do not embed source, config, manifest, or git hashes.
discrepancies.required_correction: Keep the focused results at confirmatory status or rerun through the current bound receipt path if they will drive architecture decisions.

conclusion.statement: The repository has substantial local implementation, mechanics, pilots, and several tightly scoped bound results. It has not exhausted all local scientific work. P4 is complete and governor-closed. Twenty-two new F rows now have independently verified toy or mechanics receipts, but retain their natural, environmental, social, or physical evidence ceilings. The active boundary is the memory-gated P5 sequence, the progressive P6 ladder, one bounded implementation row, remaining preregistration-only science, and rights-clean citable-input work for E6/DR14 and other studies, not a measured Studio requirement.
